function.description: Search prediction events by keyword across all categories and providers — use this to find a SPECIFIC event/topic by name (e.g. "bitcoin", "election") instead of browsing via solana.predict.events. Once you have a marketId/eventId from the results, use solana.predict.market or solana.predict.event for full detail.
function.name: solana__predict__search

includeMarkets.description: Include each event's nested markets array (default false — lean; use solana.predict.event for one event's markets).

limit.description: Max results, 1-20 (default 20). The provider ignores this param upstream — Vex enforces the requested count locally.

provider.description: Provider: kalshi, polymarket, or bisonfi (Jupiter Forecast). Default polymarket.

query.description: Search keyword or phrase, e.g. "bitcoin" or "super bowl".
